# CG-RES-002: Response property became optional

A required response property is now optional.

**Why it matters:** A guaranteed field may now be absent.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.requiredChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Property "{property}" is no longer guaranteed in {where}.
>
> Consumers that read "{property}" without checking for absence may fail.
>
> **Fix:** Keep "{property}" required, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: email became optional

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id, email], properties: {id: {}, email: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id], properties: {id: {}, email: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Property "email" is no longer guaranteed in GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Does not fire: request direction

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id, email], properties: {id: {}, email: {}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id], properties: {id: {}, email: {}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml

  ignore:
    - rule: CG-RES-002
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-RES-002: { severity: low }
```
